description: A system for a small clinic where patients book appointments with doctors online and staff manage doctors and bookings.
data: patients with full name, phone number (unique), optional email and optional date of birth
doctors with full name, specialty and optional phone number
appointments with patient, doctor, start date and time, optional reason and status (booked or cancelled)
actions: anyone can see the list of doctors
patients book an appointment with a doctor
staff add, edit and remove doctors
rules: a doctor cannot have two booked appointments that overlap
appointments cannot be booked in the past
cancelled appointments are kept, not deleted
each patient phone number is unique
